statement: Build a one-file website for Petal & Stem, a flower shop in Jaipur, where visitors can see the bouquets with prices, place a delivery order through WhatsApp, and find the shop timings and location.
audience: People in Jaipur who want to buy flowers for delivery or visit the shop at 12 MI Road, many on a phone.
standards: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
Prices in rupees, shown exactly as given
Works on a phone (360px wide) and a desktop (1280px wide)
rules: Use only the facts the Requester supplied; invent no bouquets, prices, areas or contact details
Orders go to WhatsApp +91 98290 11223 and payment is on delivery; no online payment
Photo spots stay empty placeholders until real photos are supplied
done_when: The page shows the shop name Petal & Stem and mentions Jaipur.
The page lists exactly these bouquets with prices: Red rose dozen ₹899, Sunflower bunch ₹699, Mixed seasonal ₹999, White lilies ₹1,199, Orchid box ₹1,499.
Each bouquet has an empty image placeholder spot.
An order form lets a visitor pick a bouquet and enter name, phone and delivery address, and its submit action opens a WhatsApp message to +91 98290 11223 with those details filled in.
The page states same day delivery inside Jaipur for orders before 4pm, a ₹99 delivery charge, and pay on delivery.
The page shows shop timings of 9am to 8pm Monday to Saturday and closed on Sunday.
The page shows the address 12 MI Road, near Panch Batti, Jaipur 302001, the phone +91 141 400 5566 as a tap-to-call link, and a map link or embed for the address.
The file has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and no broken in-page links.
visitor_needs: Know delivery terms: same day inside Jaipur before 4pm, ₹99 charge, pay on delivery
Find the shop address and phone
